latestRelease.bodyEn: Settings now use multiple tabs: Basic and Plugins are separated, so language, startup launch, update checks, desktop notifications, and developer logs no longer compete with plugin toggles.
bulletsZh: 设置页重构为多 Tab：基础设置 和 插件管理 分离，语言、开机自启、更新检查、桌面通知、开发者日志不再与插件开关混在一起。
插件管理优化：隐藏插件内部版本展示，保留 manifest 版本字段用于后续单插件升级；新增搜索、分类筛选和启用数量统计，避免插件数量增加后列表过长。
新增开机自启开关：接入 Tauri autostart 插件，可在设置中控制 DevNexus 是否随系统登录启动。
bulletsEn: Settings now use multiple tabs: Basic and Plugins are separated, so language, startup launch, update checks, desktop notifications, and developer logs no longer compete with plugin toggles.

Plugin management is more scalable: plugin versions are hidden from the settings UI while remaining in manifests for future per-plugin upgrades; search, category filters, and enabled counts make the list easier to manage as more plugins are added.
Added startup launch control via the Tauri autostart plugin.
